name: MCL V18 Profit-Memory Pullback Resumption
hypothesis: The outcome-blind complete-bar pullback/resumption cohort adds a genuine second auction leg after V18 has banked profit, raising useful cadence without weakening V18 direction, branch, profit-memory, or raw-turn ownership.

lifecycle.entry: one matched-suffix MCL contract at the projected next one-minute open after the frozen completed pullback/resumption trigger
lifecycle.direction: the unchanged direction of the source V18 failed-auction trade
lifecycle.profit_memory: identical V18 failed-auction law: after a completed one-minute bar establishes 0.5% MFE, protect 25% of running MFE from the next bar with adverse gap handling
lifecycle.raw_turn: close at the next one-minute MCL open following the next raw V18 CL turn
lifecycle.clock_or_contract_reset: close at the last continuous MCL close and never reopen
lifecycle.recursion: forbidden; a re-entry profit-memory exit cannot seed another re-entry
lifecycle.overlap: forbidden; exact baseline V18 ledger remains immutable

development_gates.combined_discovery_validation_cohorts: both directions and acceptance/failure positive under primary and stress in each
development_gates.combined_full_net: strictly improves unchanged V18 under primary and stress
development_gates.combined_full_drawdown: <=125% of unchanged V18 under primary and stress

control: Invert only the 85 incremental directions over identical holds and primary costs; the control cannot alter the candidate.
if_any_gate_fails: Reject exact resumption re-entry. Do not sweep pullback count, breakout distance, activation, retention, hold, stop, timeout, session, or cohort floors.
if_development_passes: Preserve as an outcome-exposed development reference only. Missing July-2023 history, unseen prospective evidence, runtime parity, native transport, margin, preview, allocation, restart, and safety remain mandatory before a crown or capital authority.
